en.title: Rebuilding a Personal Site as a Living Field
en.description: Instead of making another paper repository, personal writing, applications, MSSP, and formalization return to their proper places.

zh.title: 把個人網站改成仍在生活的場域
zh.description: 不再建立另一座論文庫，而是讓個人文字、應用、MSSP 與形式化工作各自回到合適的位置。

en.title: MSSP's First Public Route: Starting from Open Source
en.description: Rather than introducing MSSP only through abstractions, existing projects can become public material for comparison, failure, and reconstruction.

zh.title: MSSP 的第一條公開路線：從開源專案開始
zh.description: 與其只用抽象定義介紹 MSSP，不如讓既有專案成為可比較、可失敗也可重構的公開材料。
